summary: EduPostEmployment is a UserControl within the HSPnet platform for managing and displaying staff education information post-employment. It supports CRUD operations on educational records, interactive UI components, and extensive integration with session management and object data sources. The control is highly interactive, featuring editable screens, popups, and dynamic data binding, tailored for administrators to manage education records for staff.
purpose: To provide a structured interface and workflow for managing, displaying, and editing staff educational information after employment, including the addition, update, and deletion of education records, with validations, business rules, and dependencies on user session, staff identifiers, and program information.

workflows.name: Add Education Record
steps: Populate dropdowns for DeliveryMethod, Term, TermYear, GraduationConfirmed
Insert values for ProgramID, GraduationConfirmed, DeliveryMethodCodeID, TermCodeID, TermYear

workflows.name: Edit Education Record
steps: Populate dropdowns and controls with existing values
Update values for ProgramID, GraduationConfirmed, DeliveryMethodCodeID, TermCodeID, TermYear

workflows.name: Delete Education Record
steps: Invoke StaffPostEducationDelete with UserSession and EducationID

workflows.name: Show Details Popup
steps: Show details view via modal popup extender upon row command
Switch to Edit or Add mode as needed

business_rules: Screen must be editable for add/edit/delete operations.
GraduationConfirmed dropdown value: '1' if true, '0' if false.
Cancel insert/update if page is not valid.
Session and StaffID required for data source operations.
Disable buttons and fields based on editability state.
validations: Page.IsValid required for insert/update (cancel operation if invalid).
UserSession must not be null for data selection.
calculations: ProgramID is set to 0 if dropdown empty, otherwise parsed integer.
GraduationConfirmed is boolean based on dropdown value ('0' = false, else true).
DeliveryMethodCodeID, TermCodeID, TermYear parsed as integers from dropdown.
conditions: If editable screen, show add/edit/delete buttons.
If no data and screen is editable, show add button.
If UserSession is null, cancel data source operation.
system_behavior: Populates dropdowns for DeliveryMethod, Term, TermYear, GraduationConfirmed on data bound.
Handles user session caching after operations.
Redirects after insert/update/delete to maintain page context.
Register JavaScript variables for client-side interaction.
dependencies: StaffID required for select and insert.
Dropdown controls for DeliveryMethod, Term, TermYear, GraduationConfirmed.
Grid and FormView controls for presenting and editing data.
exceptions: Cancel insert/update if Page.IsValid is false.
Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
Show 'no data found' UI if grid is empty and editable.
